definitions.explanation: The young of a dragonfly, which lives in water and hunts small creatures before climbing out to become an adult.

examples.japanese: ⟦{池|いけ}→池：00848_ike⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ヤゴ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I found a dragonfly nymph in the pond.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦プール→プール：02958_puuru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ヤゴ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捕|つか}まえて→捕まえる：01214_tsukamaeru⟧、トンボ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{育|そだ}てた→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧。
examples.english: We caught dragonfly nymphs in the school pool and raised them in the classroom until they became dragonflies.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Before the school pool is cleaned in early summer, many Japanese schools hold a ヤゴ⟦{救出|きゅうしゅつ}→救出：12918_kyuushutsu⟧ (nymph rescue), moving the nymphs to tanks so pupils can watch them become dragonflies.

RELATED WORDS:
- トンボ: dragonfly
- ボウフラ: mosquito larva
- ⟦{羽化|うか}→羽化：18950_uka⟧: emergence of the adult insect
